assessment: The existing rail, bounded single-turn semantic context, stored proposal approval and exact target wake form a coherent existing-deck surface. No new editor document, provider policy, background queue or layout authority is needed. Scope is substantial but bounded to one usable editor interaction; focused client/availability/browser/type gates cover the changed boundaries without a historical replay.

requiredPreCodeClarifications.condition: Use two-stage capture: pin session epoch/token, project/document and shown scope at user intent; finalize the immutable saved revision/conversation identity/request payload only after successful draft/save settlement under that same binding. Guard after every await and before each write, including parent save requests: existing apiSave dynamically reads localStorage and must not silently retoken an old action. Keep exact request/decision bodies and keys for ambiguous replay, not refreshed/rebound variants.
requiredPreCodeClarifications.staleProposal: Approval retains the stored proposal project revision. Saving newer human content can make that proposal permanently stale; refreshing metadata cannot rebase its edits. Surface a new deliberate request or canonical cancel/recovery rather than a newly rebound approval.

requiredPreCodeClarifications.condition: Selected objects restricts editable targets. The accepted readableSlides grant still permits semantic reads of the current saved slide through get_slide, including protected/hidden semantic content projected by the existing tools. Disclose the current-slide read context and selected edit boundary; do not promise selection-only model visibility or silently change tool/context policy.

After durable submission, Cancel must remain reachable while wake admission waits. Abort/supersede the UI-owned wake request if needed, then issue canonical H cancellation bound to the saved generation/turn; do not wait up to110seconds merely to release a UI mutation lock. Browser abort is not cancellation, and late wake/action callbacks cannot revive the superseded UI state.

criticalImplementationConditions: Prepare validated replacement documents off to the side; recheck session/project/document, local engine/saved revisions, pending saves and inline/data/title drafts after all asynchronous preparation, immediately before synchronous detach/attach. Existing attachLoadedProject only checks viewer identity and is insufficient unchanged. Suppress stale autosave/attachment callbacks; preserve valid slide/selection/zoom/scroll and announce undo reset.

Keep chart/table editors mounted across rail tabs, hidden/inert when inactive, with dirty callbacks. Block Assistant send/approve/refresh on unapplied grids while preserving accepted selection/revision remount policies.

Availability reads exact private numeric/email identity and canonical owner-scoped project without admin bypass, policy.open, provider/key lookup, reservation or worker. enabled is advisory flags only; action-time checks remain independent.

Polling/pages, retries and action disposal must preserve bound generation/revision and finite budgets. Refusal/storage-limit/stale states never trigger new request keys, automatic approval, history deletion, deadline revival or hidden owner-wide wake.

Retain real text rendering, explicit stored semantic proposal decisions, keyboard/IME/focus protections and measured narrow/desktop canvas stability. One isolated production-bundle browser file plus scoped screenshots is justified by this visible change; no old render/native/PG matrix by default.
